title: Allow Pillow 13 in the published dependency range
body:
## Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues for similar requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

## Summary

Please update Streamlit's published Pillow requirement from `pillow>=9.2.0,<13` to `pillow>=9.2.0,<14` and regenerate the lockfile so Streamlit can resolve Pillow 13.0.0.

## Why?

Pillow 13.0.0 was released on 2026-10-16 and contains security fixes. Streamlit 1.66.0 currently caps Pillow below 13, which prevents downstream applications from receiving the patched release. This currently blocks the Markets/scdpy services audit because Streamlit resolves Pillow 12.3.0, which has known vulnerabilities fixed in Pillow 13.0.0.

## How?

I prepared the minimal change locally:

```diff
- pillow>=9.2.0,<13
+ pillow>=9.2.0,<14
```

The lockfile resolves successfully to Pillow 13.0.0. Existing Streamlit Pillow usage is covered by the image, hashing, and write-path tests.

## Additional Context

- Current dependency metadata: https://pypi.org/pypi/streamlit/json
- Pillow 13.0.0 release: https://pypi.org/project/Pillow/13.0.0/
- Streamlit dependency policy requires runtime dependencies to be capped below the next major version until compatibility is reviewed.
- A full upstream PR was not submitted because `CONTRIBUTING.md` states that outside pull requests are currently paused.
- The prepared local commit is `50bc26e2b6` on the `fchareyr/streamlit` fork.

Focused local validation: `uv lock --check` and Ruff passed; tests require the repository's `protoc` tool, which was unavailable in the local environment.

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-17586)

If you're using [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), you can put a temporary override in your `pyproject.toml`:

```toml
[tool.uv]
# ...
override-dependencies = [
    # https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/17586
    "pillow >= 13.0",
]
```
We rolled this out as a patch in version 1.66.1 today.
